queries.sql: select rowid,service,client,auth_value,auth_reason,last_modified,boot_uuid from access where last_modified between ? and ?

select t.Z_PK,t.ZTIMESTAMP,a.ZNAME author,b.ZNAME bundle,p.ZNAME process
          from ATRANSACTION t left join ATRANSACTIONSTRING a on a.Z_PK=t.ZAUTHORTS
          left join ATRANSACTIONSTRING b on b.Z_PK=t.ZBUNDLEIDTS
          left join ATRANSACTIONSTRING p on p.Z_PK=t.ZPROCESSIDTS
          where t.ZTIMESTAMP between ? and ? order by t.ZTIMESTAMP

select p.Z_NAME entity_name,count(*) n from ACHANGE c
              left join Z_PRIMARYKEY p on c.ZENTITY=p.Z_ENT
              where c.ZTRANSACTIONID between ? and ? group by p.Z_NAME
